title: Good company along the way.
intro: The people in this garden are fictional guides to real ideas from the Mathnuscripts. Walk up, say hello, and follow the thought they’re carrying.

people.name: Wanjiku
dialogue: I keep coming back to the same question: what changes when an idea finally meets the real world?
There are plenty of projects in the workshop. But before you open one, here’s a thought about the foundations of building a startup.
people.essaySlug: Pillars of Building a Great Startup

people.name: Asha
people.greeting: Come with a question. Leave with a better one.
dialogue: The archive isn’t a place to collect answers and close the door. The interesting part is what one thought opens into.
Mathenge wrote about extending human intelligence. I think you’ll enjoy where that path leads.

people.name: Otieno
people.greeting: The coast is a good place to think about possibility.
dialogue: A boat is a small act of optimism. Someone looks at the water and decides there ought to be a way across.
There’s a similar kind of hope in building for this continent. Here’s a note to take with you before you head out.
people.essaySlug: Africa and the Discipline of Hope

people.name: Jabali
people.greeting: A little distance changes the view.
dialogue: That’s the Starling over there. It goes straight up, waits above the landscape, and comes home on its own flame.
The best part isn’t going fast. It’s seeing how all these little places belong to one world. Mathenge has a note about that kind of perspective.

people.name: Imani
people.greeting: Ready for a different kind of wandering?
dialogue: The bush plane is ready. Take it down the runway, steer into the open country, and use Return & land when you want to come home.
Choosing how to explore is half the adventure. Here’s something from the Mathnuscripts about choosing your game.
people.essaySlug: Choosing your Game will Choose Your Life
